name: Opus 5.5
tune: Brahms' Lullaby, with a bass line

notes.label: Ambition
notes.text: The most ambitious machine: a glowing brass lantern with a screw lift and eleven gated tracks.

notes.label: Motion
notes.text: Marbles truly circulate: lifted, queued, released, then they swirl down the bowl and go round again.

notes.label: Clarity
notes.text: So much moves at once that it's hard to tell which marble played which note. Struck bars flare white.

notes.label: Sound
notes.text: Warm bell tone with a bass line, but the rhythm drifts and stray ticks blur the tune.

name: Fable 5.2
tune: Frère Jacques, as a four-voice round

notes.label: Idea
notes.text: The cleverest musical idea: the spiral of 32 bars is the score, and four marbles play it as a round.

notes.label: Clarity
notes.text: Easy to follow. Each marble has its own colour, and the bar it hits glows in that colour.

notes.label: Sound
notes.text: In tune and on time. The round thins out and rebuilds, so the loop never feels like a restart.

notes.label: Looks
notes.text: Calm but a little plain. The machine sits small in the frame and the marbles look like plastic.

notes.label: Craft
notes.text: Looks like a real object: warm walnut, brass rails, glass marble tubes, soft shadows and a gentle light.

notes.label: Clarity
notes.text: One lane per bar, low to high, so you can always see which marble plays which note.

notes.label: Sound
notes.text: All four phrases of Ode to Joy, every note right and in time, with a clean marimba tone.

notes.label: Trade-off
notes.text: The safest design of the four: a straight row of tracks. Marbles are small, and the on-screen text competes a little.

notes.label: Sound
notes.text: The tune is right and steady, with a soft bell tone and a calm pause before each repeat.

notes.label: Physics
notes.text: After hitting a bar, marbles hover in mid-air in front of it instead of rolling down the ramp.

notes.label: Looks
notes.text: Tidy layout, but the brass and bars look flat and plastic, and the clear marbles are hard to see.

notes.label: Camera
notes.text: The orbit swings close and low, so the machine is often cropped or seen through its own frame.
